subtitleStandard: Ask anything. Your question goes to 4 AI models simultaneously.
subtitlePremium: Ask anything. 4 AI models debate your question in multiple rounds, then vote blindly on the best answer.
premiumModeBanner: PREMIUM MODE — DEEPER REASONING · BLIND VOTING · HIGHEST QUALITY ANSWER
multiModelDetail: Your prompt is sent simultaneously to GPT-4o, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok. Each answers independently before synthesis begins.
consensusDetail: A synthesis pass analyzes where models agreed, partially overlapped, or conflicted. Color-coded: green for consensus, yellow for partial, red for conflict.
debateDetail: In Premium mode, models go through 2 rounds of debate, then vote blindly on the best answer. Majority wins, ties broken by Claude.
transparencyDetail: Every answer shows each model's individual output. Premium also shows the full debate history and how each model voted.

info_description: VELE AI is a multi-model synthesis platform that queries multiple leading AI models simultaneously and synthesizes their responses into a single, high-quality answer. Instead of choosing one AI, you get the combined intelligence of many.
info_standard_desc: All four AI models answer your question independently and simultaneously. VELE then synthesizes their responses into one cohesive, confident answer — with a score showing how much the models agreed.
info_std_step2: All 4 models answer simultaneously and independently
info_std_step3: VELE synthesizes their responses into one cohesive answer
info_std_step4: You see a confidence score showing how much the models agreed
info_std_bullet2: When you need one solid answer fast
info_premium_desc: Premium takes multi-model AI to the next level. Models don't just answer — they debate. After seeing each other's reasoning, they vote blindly on the best response. You get the full debate transcript plus the winner.
info_pre_step2: Round 1: All 4 models give their initial response
info_pre_step3: Round 2: Models see each other's answers and refine their thinking
info_pre_step4: Round 3: Models vote blindly on the best answer
info_pre_step5: You see the full debate, all perspectives, and the winner
info_pre_bullet1: Important decisions that need multiple expert perspectives
info_pre_bullet2: Complex topics where disagreement reveals insight
info_pre_bullet4: Finding and catching errors (models debate each other)
info_models_desc: VELE queries a hand-picked set of leading AI models. The synthesis engine weighs and merges their outputs to reduce individual model blind spots and hallucinations.
info_gpt_desc: Best for creative writing, coding, and general intelligence tasks. Strength: versatile, broadly capable.
info_claude_desc: Best for reasoning, nuance, careful analysis. Strength: thoughtful, well-balanced responses.
info_deepseek_desc: Best for technical depth, math, and research. Strength: deep technical knowledge.
info_grok_desc: Best for current events and unique perspectives. Strength: real-time knowledge, unconventional thinking.
info_why_heading: No single model is always right
info_why_desc: Each AI model has unique strengths, training data, and failure modes. By running your query across multiple models and synthesizing the results, VELE delivers more balanced, accurate, and comprehensive answers than any single model alone.
info_why_catch_label: MULTI-MODEL SYNTHESIS CATCHES WHAT SINGLE MODELS MISS
info_web_desc: Web search powered by Tavily is available in both Standard and Premium modes. Toggle it on to give models access to live information before they answer.
info_web_powered: Powered by Tavily · available in Standard and Premium modes
